stories.headline_en: Trump, Xi, and Putin Prepare for Historic Trilateral Summit in Shenzhen
stories.summary_en: US President Donald Trump, Chinese President Xi Jinping, and Russian President Vladimir Putin are set to meet on the sidelines of the APEC summit in Shenzhen. Marking the first trilateral discussion among leaders of the three major powers, the agenda is expected to touch upon nuclear armament and regional security.
stories.why_en: The unprecedented summit brings together the world's most powerful military leaders amid shifting global alliances, high economic tensions, and ongoing international conflicts.

sources.title: What do Trump, Putin and Xi want from their Shenzhen meeting?
Apec summit as it happened: Xi welcomes Trump on China visit as Putin claims Europe in ‘humiliating decline’

stories.headline_en: International Court of Justice to Deliver Landmark Ruling on Myanmar Genocide
stories.summary_en: The International Court of Justice in The Hague is preparing to deliver its verdict in a case brought by The Gambia accusing Myanmar of state-led genocide against its Rohingya minority during a 2017 military campaign. Myanmar denies the allegations, maintaining its forces were conducting legitimate security operations.
stories.why_en: A finding against Myanmar would mark the first time the UN's highest court has held a sovereign state responsible for committing genocide under the 1948 Genocide Convention.

sources.title: ICJ to rule on Rohingya genocide case against Myanmar
Myanmar faces historic genocide verdict at UN court over Rohingya massacres

stories.headline_en: Anthropic Valued at Up to $1.5 Trillion Ahead of Public Debut
stories.summary_en: Artificial intelligence firm Anthropic is set to begin trading on the Nasdaq at $83 per share, giving the company a valuation of up to $1.5 trillion. The maker of the Claude AI assistant is the first US company solely dedicated to artificial intelligence to launch an initial public offering.
stories.why_en: The record-setting debut will serve as a crucial barometer for whether massive financial investments across the generative AI sector can deliver sustainable profitability.

sources.title: AI giant Anthropic valued at up to $1.5tn ahead of stock market debut
The seven Anthropic founders who are about to become multi-billionaires
Can Anthropic's record-breaking IPO stop the AI bubble bursting?

stories.headline_en: UK Government Introduces Legislation to Abolish Leasehold System for Flats
stories.summary_en: Ministers in the UK have proposed the Commonhold and Leasehold Reform Bill to phase out leasehold arrangements for new flats in England and Wales, replacing them with commonhold ownership. The legislation also caps existing ground rents at £250 annually before phasing them down entirely over 40 years.
stories.why_en: The reform seeks to replace a centuries-old property structure with shared-ownership standards common in other developed economies, altering the rights of millions of flat owners.

sources.title: 'Feudal' leasehold system set to be scrapped in England and Wales

stories.headline_en: Van Gogh Painting Fetches Record $190.4 Million at Auction
stories.summary_en: Vincent van Gogh's late masterpiece 'Chestnut Trees in Blossom' has sold at Sotheby's in New York for $190.4 million, establishing a new auction record for the Dutch artist. The auction proceeded following a settlement between the sellers and the heirs of a German publisher who owned the artwork before World War Two.
stories.why_en: The transaction represents the highest price ever achieved at auction for Van Gogh and highlights continued international efforts to resolve complex Nazi-era ownership disputes.

sources.title: Van Gogh painting sells for record $190.4m after row over its Nazi history
